note: Unmodified public SharedObject regression fixtures from Ruffle. These files were not generated by NeoFlash. Upstream test sources and expected traces accompany each source_path; this directory selects the MIT license option.

amf0_sol_references.note: Native SOL AMF0 reserves slots for inline primitives and complex values; references reuse slots. The untouched self-reference fixture establishes saved=true followed by foo.self=foo at reference 1. Further inline/reference accounting is checked against the pinned writer rather than assumed from its decoder (which counts reference markers differently). Standard AMF0 values use an object-only table. NeoFlash implements this profile independently; no upstream codec code is copied.

sparse_array_reference.note: The unmodified fixture includes an AMF0 ECMA sparseArray with a length hint of 6 and only indices 0 and 5. The smaller sparse0 literal in tests/amf.rs is independently authored from this structure and AMF0 section 2.12, with replacement values rather than copied fixture bytes.

amf3_sparse_literal.note: The 14-byte sparse3 literal in tests/amf.rs matches the public ARRAY WITH HOLES case in this pinned source. It has numeric associative key 20 and three dense values; absent indices remain absent. Only the wire example is reused; no algorithm is copied.
